ranking_basis: Qualitative dependency and scientific utility; not novelty priority, estimated ease or percentage of the continuum problem. AR and AS remain fundamental obligations.
selection_rule: This cycle stops at exactly three investigations. Future execution requires a new instruction and a prospective first contract; select each later target after its preceding review.

goals.title: Identify the numerical-cap bulk state
goals.target: Derive an explicit spatial boundary estimate for the AQ model and use it to test whole-sequence convergence and uniqueness of the declared full-lattice limit.
goals.missing_premise: AQ proves subsequential existence and a simple vacuum within its GNS representation; it does not give a quantitative comparison of different thermodynamic limits.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze two centered/bulk exhaustions of the same repeated selected-strip Hamiltonian. Derive or reject one explicit norm-one local-observable boundary estimate at a declared numerical interval, including all complete factors and original endpoints.
goals.second_loop_rule: After the first skeptical review, either use the actual bound to prove the specified all-pairs local Cauchy/state-identification result, or isolate the missing estimate with a discriminating countercontrol.
goals.exact_model: Full coarse Z3, actual complete 24-link factors, fixed repeated selected triple, whole-star omission and physical scales; AQ state at |tau|<=10^-8. Any comparison to AN or old orthant states retains their additional common hypothesis range and deep-bulk observation map.
goals.reason_for_rank: Closes the main identification gap exposed by the newly completed numerical-cap construction. Rank reflects scientific dependency, not predicted ease.
limitations: Do not identify a fixed-origin orthant boundary state with the full-lattice bulk state.
AM2 does not evaluate HTW constants. A simple GNS vacuum is not uniqueness of all states.

goals.title: Test a different weak-coupling reference strategy
goals.target: Select one source-grounded alternative reference or multiscale candidate and test whether its complete dimensionless interaction dictionary can follow a weak-bare-coupling trajectory.
goals.missing_premise: The current selected-strip sufficient regime has tau=96/g^4 and cannot approach g=0. Common energy/time rescaling leaves this obstruction unchanged.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze one alternate reference, full original Hamiltonian, boundary prescription and physical-clock map; compute the actual normalized local interaction along a specified weak-coupling path. Preserve an insufficient outcome if no eligible route is found.
goals.second_loop_rule: Only if the first dictionary passes review, derive or simulate one bounded stability/scale-matching test with explicit error; otherwise select a concrete obstruction or model-distinction test.
goals.exact_model: A newly declared candidate must map to the actual uniform SU(2) Hamiltonian or explicitly state its deformation; no automatic transfer from AQ.
goals.reason_for_rank: Addresses the most consequential unresolved route toward the continuum target, while recognizing that it is substantially harder than a routine corollary.
limitations: Independent magnetic suppression changes the action and is not merely a change of units.
No continuum construction follows from one finite-scale test.

goals.title: Certify actual AQ Euclidean data
goals.target: Produce one rigorously enclosed centered Euclidean correlation sample in the chosen AQ state, or isolate the missing estimate that prevents the required absolute accuracy.
goals.missing_premise: AT3 supplies a conditional finite-data readout but no actual AQ samples. Finite-volume/boundary/state, representation-cutoff, solver and arithmetic errors have not been bounded together for such a sample.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze one nonzero dimensionless time, physical clock, exact chosen AQ state and Wilson centering, finite graph/cutoff and absolute tolerance before computing. Bound all errors and retain an insufficient verdict if any required estimate is missing.
goals.second_loop_rule: After a new first-loop review, decide whether to extend to the frozen4097-node AT3 schedule, improve a necessary bound, or stop with a quantified obstruction.
goals.exact_model: Same chosen AQ numerical-cap state, centered original Wilson, complete original factors, fixed physical energy and clock. Abstract A/B controls and separate AU/AP models cannot supply AQ observations.
goals.reason_for_rank: Most bounded next response deliverable, conditional on a genuine sample-production certificate; difficulty and physical significance differ from the finite readout arithmetic.
limitations: No actual sample computed in Round30.
Shape-valid CSV input does not certify its physical provenance or error budget.

goals.title: Evaluate the certified 561-state heat output
goals.target: Turn the inherited exact-semigroup error theorem into an exported, reproducible numerical vector/evaluator with a rigorous full-output error budget.
goals.missing_premise: AH1/AH2 provide structural and exact-semigroup estimates; the final certified 561-coordinate output has not been evaluated.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze graph, representation span, input, Haar Gram metric, separate ground centers and a requested tolerance. Implement one certified heat-action evaluation with interval or rigorous residual/tail control.
goals.second_loop_rule: After reviewing the actual output and error denominator, extend to one declared time range/input or diagnose the failing resource bound.
goals.exact_model: The inherited finite physical graph and AH1/AH2 561-coordinate generated span; complete outside-channel and truncation controls remain mandatory.
goals.reason_for_rank: Converts an existing theorem into a usable reproducible calculator without confusing finite numerical evidence with a continuum proof.
limitations: All-time true-relative error requires the actual full-output denominator.
An exact matrix-exponential symbol is not an evaluated numerical artifact.

goals.title: Test inference with a design fixed from the prior
goals.target: Test canonical-model parameter inference under one schedule chosen before observing candidate outcomes, with independently varying nuisance parameters and complete physical errors.
goals.missing_premise: Prior results identify conditional candidate separations; they do not yet validate one prior-fixed design over independently varying candidates.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze a compact prior, observable/clock dictionary, one observation schedule and acceptance margin, then compute candidate intervals with independent nuisance variations and all inherited error terms.
goals.second_loop_rule: Choose the second investigation from the first review: certify a supported separation region, or derive an unresolved/inseparable counterfamily and revise the future design rule.
goals.exact_model: The separate canonical summable model and physical readout maps of AI3/AI4; do not import the homogeneous AQ state or its gap.
goals.reason_for_rank: Preserves the previously proposed AP question under its original identity and keeps useful inference work distinct from homogeneous-gap evidence.
limitations: An unresolved result is allowed and must remain visible.
A design optimized after seeing candidate outcomes does not answer the prior-fixed question.

closed_subgoal: AT same-state moment, spectral-window/inverse-form bounds, conditional finite readout and abstract benchmark tests are complete within scope; actual response production remains open.
